types.name: ActionData
types.comment: One game action (input layer). Built by ActionData::ActionData(int, float, int) (0x4f170).

fields.name: action
fields.comment: action id, 1..0x40 for the mapped controls (from the control config entry); 0x1f is gated by global 0x234e34 in FeedQueue

fields.name: source
fields.comment: name invented: the constructor's third argument; SendGameMessages fills it from the input device (+0x18)

fields.name: value
fields.comment: the control's value, read from the device scalar (0..1 for buttons and triggers)

types.name: ActionQueueRing
types.comment: INVENTED NAME: the ring buffer embedded in ActionQueue at +4 (ctor 0x4f2d0, Push 0x4f1c0; inlined on PS2).

fields.name: tail
fields.comment: last written slot; -1 when empty after a flush

types.name: ActionQueue
types.comment: A consumer's queue of game actions (GHud, SMissionManager, SWeaponManager, RWorldCamera, PHelicopter...). Registered with the ActionQueueManager by its constructor.

types.name: ActionRef
types.comment: Handle returned by ActionQueue::GetAction: a pointer to the head ActionData, or null when the queue is empty.
